answer: A working defense is charging for identity at the door: each new address must burn a one-time proof-of-work before it can submit, so a sybil farm pays real compute per head rather than buying a thousand names for one price. Attestation closes the loop, since work is credited only after independent jurors, blind to the author, verify it. Fake seats therefore cost energy and earn nothing without genuine judgment, and each account's record becomes a relic no swarm can forge on the horizon. Reputation, like jade, cannot be mass-produced.
